source.quote: On November 18th, 2025, we notified developers using `chatgpt-4o-latest` model snapshot of its deprecation and removal from the API on February 17, 2026.

tasks.reasoning:
This one task covers all 10 openai changes that affect this repo. Handle every one of them in this single change set, prove each with your test, and say in finish which you changed and which needed no change.

1. chatgpt-4o-latest (Feb 17, 2026) and codex-mini-latest with legacy local shell tool (Feb 12, 2026) removed (model-retirement, effective 2026-02-17)
   Source: https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/deprecations.md
   Quote: On November 18th, 2025, we notified developers using `chatgpt-4o-latest` model snapshot of its deprecation and removal from the API on February 17, 2026.
   Affects: fields: model:chatgpt-4o-latest, model:codex-mini-latest
   Call sites: src/ai/ai.service.ts:63 (model value not visible; check for chatgpt-4o-latest); src/ai/dispatch-email-llm.service.ts:121 (modelName from config/env; check value); src/ai/task-assignment-llm.service.ts:229 (model value not visible; check); src/assistant/openai-notification.client.ts:95 (model value not visible; check); src/assistant/openai-suggestion.client.ts:65 (model value not visible; check); src/market-intelligence/market-intelligence.service.ts:443 (model value not visible; check); src/meeting/meeting.service.ts:574 (model value not visible; check); src/meeting/meeting.service.ts:656 (modelStart variable; check value); src/meeting/meeting.service.ts:755 (model value not visible; check); src/meeting/meeting.service.ts:937 (model value not visible; check); src/pm/proposal-plan-generator.service.ts:162 (model value not visible; check)
   Why it applies: chatgpt-4o-latest was removed on 2026-02-17. The repo makes 11 chat.completions.create calls, and the scan did not record which model strings they use (several are variables or env values). If any resolves to chatgpt-4o-latest, the call already fails. The migration agent should grep for chatgpt-4o-latest in code, env defaults and .env examples, and replace it with a supported model. codex-mini-latest and the local shell tool are not used by this repo. If no match is found, close the task with no change.

2. gpt-4-0314 and gpt-4-0125-preview/gpt-4-turbo-preview shut down Mar 26, 2026 (model-retirement, effective 2026-03-26)
   Source: https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/deprecations.md
   Quote: Access to these models was shut down on March 26, 2026.
   Affects: fields: model:gpt-4-0314, model:gpt-4-0125-preview, model:gpt-4-turbo-preview
   Call sites: src/ai/ai.service.ts:63 (model value unknown; check for gpt-4-0314/gpt-4-turbo-preview); src/ai/dispatch-email-llm.service.ts:121 (modelName from config; check); src/ai/task-assignment-llm.service.ts:229 (model value unknown; check); src/assistant/openai-notification.client.ts:95 (model value unknown; check); src/assistant/openai-suggestion.client.ts:65 (model value unknown; check); src/market-intelligence/market-intelligence.service.ts:443 (model value unknown; check); src/meeting/meeting.service.ts:574 (model value unknown; check); src/meeting/meeting.service.ts:656 (modelStart variable; check); src/meeting/meeting.service.ts:755 (model value unknown; check); src/meeting/meeting.service.ts:937 (model value unknown; check); src/pm/proposal-plan-generator.service.ts:162 (model value unknown; check)
   Why it applies: gpt-4-0314, gpt-4-0125-preview and gpt-4-turbo-preview were shut down on 2026-03-26. The chat.completions.create calls take their model from variables or config that the scan did not resolve, so it is uncertain whether any uses these names. The migration agent should search code and env defaults for them and replace any hit with a currently supported model. If none is found, no change is needed.

3. dall-e-2/dall-e-3 and Realtime beta header removed May 12, 2026; realtime preview/audio-preview models May 7, 2026 (model-retirement, effective 2026-05-12)
   Source: https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/deprecations.md
   Quote: On November 14th, 2025, we notified developers using DALL·E model snapshots of their deprecation and removal from the API on May 12, 2026.
   Affects: fields: model:dall-e-2, model:dall-e-3, model:gpt-4o-realtime-preview, model:gpt-4o-audio-preview
   Call sites: src/realtime/realtime-voice.service.ts:4 (pins model gpt-4o-realtime-preview, which was removed May 7, 2026); src/realtime/realtime-voice.service.ts:25 (WebSocket to wss://api.openai.com/v1/realtime with the removed model; may also send the retired OpenAI-Beta: realtime=v1 header)
   Why it applies: The repo hard-codes gpt-4o-realtime-preview for its realtime voice WebSocket. That model was removed in May 2026, so the connection fails already. The Realtime beta header also went away, so the migration agent should check whether the socket sends OpenAI-Beta: realtime=v1 and drop it, and check the session/event schema for GA differences. Switch the model to gpt-realtime-2.1 or gpt-realtime-2.1-mini. This also covers the legacy realtime/audio retirement on 2027-01-20. DALL-E is not used.

4. computer-use-preview, search-preview, gpt-5-codex, gpt-5.1-codex*, deep-research and chat-latest snapshots shut down Jul 23, 2026; use gpt-5.6-* (model-retirement, effective 2026-07-23)

record.prBody:
## 10 changes: chatgpt-4o-latest (Feb 17, 2026) and codex-mini-latest with legacy local shell tool (Feb 12, 2026) removed and more [Verified]

### Change

No repo use of chatgpt-4o-latest or codex-mini-latest (task 1 needed no change; likewise none of the gpt-4-0314/gpt-5*/o-series/search/codex ids in notices 2, 4, 6, 8, 10). Actual hits were the gpt-4o-mini defaults for OPENAI_MODEL and the per-feature model vars (Jan 14 2027 notice, notice 9), now gpt-6-luna in src, .env.example and docs. In the 3 OpenAI calls using max_tokens/temperature (dispatch-email, task-assignment, proposal-plan) I renamed max_tokens to max_completion_tokens and removed temperature (Gemini params left alone). Realtime (notice 3): model gpt-realtime-2.1, removed OpenAI-Beta header, GA session.update shape (pcm 24k, voice under audio.output), event renamed to response.output_audio.delta. Notice 5 (openai 7.x / Node 22) optional, not done. Added src/realtime/realtime-voice.spec.ts.

Files touched:
- `.env.example`
- `docs/CONFIGURATION_NESTJS_ASSISTANT_CONTEXT.md`
- `docs/NESTJS_CONFIG_BACKEND.md`
- `docs/NESTJS_REALTIME_VOICE.md`
- `src/ai/ai.service.ts`
- `src/ai/dispatch-email-llm.service.ts`
- `src/ai/task-assignment-llm.service.ts`
- `src/assistant/openai-notification.client.ts`
- `src/assistant/openai-suggestion.client.ts`
- `src/market-intelligence/market-intelligence.service.ts`
- `src/meeting/meeting.service.ts`
- `src/pm/proposal-plan-generator.service.ts`
- `src/realtime/realtime-voice.service.ts`
- `src/realtime/realtime-voice.spec.ts`

### Why

gpt-4o-mini and gpt-4o-realtime-preview are retired/retiring, and gpt-6-luna is a reasoning model that rejects max_tokens and non-default temperature.

> On November 18th, 2025, we notified developers using `chatgpt-4o-latest` model snapshot of its deprecation and removal from the API on February 17, 2026.

Source: https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/deprecations.md

### Proof

| Check | Before | After | New failures |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| typecheck | pass | pass | 0 |
| build | pass | pass | 0 |
| test | pass | pass | 0 |
| proof | fail (1) | pass | 0 |

New failures: 0

Checks added by the agent (they count toward proof; check that each command really tests the change):
- proof, added by the agent: `export MONGO_URI='mongodb://user:pass@localhost:27017/db' JWT_SECRET='placeholder'; npx jest src/realtime` (fail (1) → pass)

Provider tool calls recorded by the harness:
- `openai__openai_check_request`: pass

The agent's validator claims (not proof; graded against the recorded calls):
- openai_check_request: pass (chat.completions with gpt-6-luna, max_completion_tokens, response_format: no unknown or deprecated params (top-level keys only))

Prepared before the baseline:
- Checks ran with placeholder env: MONGO_URI, JWT_SECRET.

Test of this change: `proof`, written by the agent and run with the checks.

Where checks ran: Docker container node:22-bookworm; install scripts disabled; no host env or mounts besides the repo copy; no credentials, so no live API calls

### Unproven

- Realtime GA session schema and event names written from the recipe, not verified against live docs; audio formats vs client gateway unchecked
- gpt-6-luna with response_format json_object not confirmed
- max_completion_tokens now includes reasoning tokens; 4096 cap could shorten output
- Deployed OPENAI_MODEL / OPENAI_*_MODEL env overrides naming gpt-4o-mini still need updating
- openai_model_lookup not run
- dist/ is stale until rebuilt

### Behaviour changes

- Default model gpt-4o-mini -> gpt-6-luna: quality, latency, cost differ
- temperature (0.15/0.2) no longer sent to OpenAI in 3 calls; model default applies
- max_tokens -> max_completion_tokens
- Realtime: new model, no beta header, GA session and event names
